title: Migrate CI from Jenkins to GitHub Actions
description: Migrate the existing Jenkins-based CI pipelines to GitHub Actions workflows, then cut over and decommission Jenkins.

tasks.text: Inventory all Jenkins jobs, pipelines, and their triggers
Document plugins, credentials, and shared libraries in use
Map build agents, environments, and external integrations
Translate each Jenkins pipeline into a GitHub Actions workflow YAML
Migrate secrets and credentials to GitHub encrypted secrets
Run workflows in parallel with Jenkins and compare results
Switch branch protection and required checks to GitHub Actions
Disable Jenkins jobs and archive build history
Decommission Jenkins servers and revoke obsolete credentials
